product.name: Honeydew Semantic Layer
product.description: A semantic layer that provides a shared source of truth for business metrics and logic, enabling consistent data access across AI and BI tools.

product.name: Dynamic Datasets
product.description: Configurable datasets built from semantic layer components, deployable as views, tables, or dynamic tables in Snowflake for flexible data exploration and integration.

product.name: Snowflake Integration
product.description: Integration with Snowflake data warehouse enabling deployment and management of semantic models and dynamic datasets with various authentication methods.

product.name: AI-Powered Natural Language Querying
product.description: Capability allowing business users to query data in natural language via interfaces like Slack, powered by the semantic layer to ensure consistent and accurate answers.

identifier.value: Semantic Layer Management and Collaboration Tools

product.name: Semantic Layer Management and Collaboration Tools
product.description: Tools for managing, versioning, and collaborating on semantic models using SQL and YAML, with lineage tracking and impact analysis.
